title: get_all_blogs_without_authentication
description: Verify that the GET /api/blogs endpoint returns all blog posts without requiring user authentication.

title: create_blog_post_with_authentication
description: Verify that the POST /api/blogs endpoint allows an authenticated user to create a new blog post using their JWT identity.

title: update_blog_post_by_original_author
description: Verify that the PUT /api/blogs/:id endpoint allows only the original author (authenticated user) to update their blog post.

title: delete_blog_post_by_original_author
description: Verify that the DELETE /api/blogs/:id endpoint allows only the original author (authenticated user) to delete their blog post.

title: register_new_user_account
description: Verify that the POST /api/users/register endpoint successfully registers a new user account without requiring authentication.

title: user_login_and_jwt_token_return
description: Verify that the POST /api/users/login endpoint authenticates a user and returns a valid JWT token.

title: health_check_endpoint_response
description: Verify that the GET /health endpoint returns a basic health message confirming the backend service is running and responsive.
